text: Standard card FX fee for residents of Germany: 1.5%. UK residents pay 2%. Effective 2026-09-01.
The virtual card has a monthly fee of 0 EUR. No physical card is offered.
Monthly ATM withdrawals: up to 200 EUR inclusive at 0%; amounts above 200 EUR at 2% marginally.
Premium earns 3% in USDC, capped at 50 USD each month, excluding cash withdrawals.
ATM fees depend on the operator and are disclosed at the terminal. The issuer is Example Bank.
Core is virtual only. Luxe offers physical and virtual cards. Each tier has its own eligibility requirements.
